title: OASIS Workflow
description: A contributed, data-only recipe: an ordered (chain) or parallel (fanout) sequence of INTENT IDs for a compound goal no single endpoint serves. References intents only — never endpoints; the index resolves each step to live endpoints at serve time. OASIS suggests the route; the agent executes it.

goal.description: The compound user goal in one line — what the whole recipe accomplishes.

shape.description: chain = ordered pipeline (each step feeds the next); fanout = parallel enrichment of one held entity.

aliases.description: Natural-language phrasings the goal is matched against (like an intent's aliases).

steps.description: The ordered/parallel steps. Each names an existing intent id.

intent.description: An existing curated intent id (domain.snake_case) — resolved to endpoints at serve time.

do.description: What this step accomplishes toward the goal (human-facing).

optional.description: The workflow still succeeds if this step is skipped.

gate.description: A precondition/stop rule the executing agent must honor (e.g. 'stop if risk is high', 'require human confirmation').

produces.description: The final artifact/outcome the agent synthesizes from the step outputs. OASIS does not run the steps.
